settings.title: Settings
settings.choose_the_ldap_domain_to_use: Choose the LDAP domain to use
settings.mail_from_format: Must be a valid mail address
settings.nethvoice_auth_url_placeholder_tooltip: The URL used to authenticate users against NethVoice. It should point to the FreePBX External Auth endpoint. If not set, NethVoice mobile app chat integration will be disabled.

matrix.failed: The operation failed. Check the application log for details.
matrix.identity_hint: User IDs end with this domain. It is fixed after the first setup.
matrix.certificates: Request Let's Encrypt certificates through NS8
matrix.registration_hint: Public registration always requires a token. Create tokens using Ketesa or the Synapse admin API.
matrix.ldap_hint: Leave empty for local Matrix accounts. The recovery administrator is always available as a local account.
matrix.media_ip: Reachable IPv4 address of this node
matrix.call_hint: MatrixRTC supports current Element clients. coturn supports classic calls. Forward the media ports shown on the Status page when the node is behind a router.
matrix.extension_hint: Enable only the services you use. The JSON editor extends the bundled upstream configuration; NS8 manages service addresses, databases and registration tokens.
matrix.help_telegram: Enter your Telegram API ID and hash under network.api_id and network.api_hash. Obtain them from my.telegram.org.
matrix.help_draupnir: Set managementRoom to an existing room ID or alias, invite @draupnir to it and grant the bot the power levels it needs in protected rooms.
matrix.help_buscarron: Define BUSCARRON_LIST and the BUSCARRON_<FORM>_ROOM variables. Its web endpoint receives form submissions.
matrix.help_postmoogle: Set POSTMOOGLE_DOMAINS. Deliver incoming mail through an SMTP relay to the port on the Status page. Add relay settings for outgoing mail if needed.
matrix.backup_hint: Use the NS8 backup screen. Backups briefly stop writers, snapshot databases and sessions, then resume services. Weekly cleanup removes only stopped containers belonging to this module.
matrix.recovery_hint: These local credentials also work when LDAP is unavailable. Generating a new Matrix password logs out existing recovery-admin devices.
matrix.pending: A configuration change still needs to finish. Check the log and save the settings again.
matrix.port_hint: HTTPS traffic uses NS8 Traefik. Database and bridge control ports listen only on localhost.
